metadata.description: AST-expansion conformance fixture for the mom6_cgrid pressure-gradient rule pair (grids/mom6_cgrid/rules/mom6_cgrid_diff_x/y.esm, with the face-thickness averages mom6_cgrid_avg_u/v.esm) at N_I = N_J = 8, N_K = 3 (the traced stage-2 subdomain of EqESM stage2/mom6_momentum.esm): the same five equations as the consuming PressureGradientForce model — P_int = pa_top*h + intz_dpa, the east/north face pressure-difference groups dP_x = -diff_x(P_int) + (diff_x(h)*intx_pa - diff_x(e_bot)*intx_dpa*Z_to_H) and dP_y = -diff_y(P_int) + (diff_y(h)*inty_pa - diff_y(e_bot)*inty_dpa*Z_to_H) (the g1 + (g2f - g2s) grouping of PressureForce_FV_Bouss :1797-1805, bit-exact against the dump, built from the east/north face forward differences of MOM_PressureForce_FV.F90:1795-1813 with the explicit mirrored 0 wall regions at i = N_I / j = N_J), and the face accelerations PFu = 2*I_Rho0*IdxCu*dP_x/(2*avg_u(h) + h_neglect) and PFv = 2*I_Rho0*IdyCv*dP_y/(2*avg_v(h) + h_neglect) (the 0.5 face averages of avg_u/avg_v doubled back to the exact h_c + h_e/h_n + h_neglect denominator — exact since the 0.5 factor is a power of two — with the mirrored wall regions). Forces expansion of the diff rules' 0-valued wall regions and the avg rules' mirrored wall regions at the domain edges; every apply_expression_template node of the named-op rules must inline, and the lowered AST must carry zero unlowered rewrite-target ops and zero surviving metaparameter names (N_I/N_J/N_K bound to 8/8/3 at the grid import edge). The stage-2 test pins (stage2/mom6_momentum.esm) carry the numeric comparison against the Fortran dumps at the interior faces; this fixture pins the byte-identical post-lowering AST over the whole subdomain.
metadata.name: mom6_cgrid_momentum_pgf_ast_fixture

mom6_adcroft_reciprocal.description: The guarded reciprocal of the MOM6 grid metrics (Adcroft_reciprocal, MOM_grid_initialize.F90:1173-1179): 1/x, or exactly 0.0 when x == 0.0. The grid's metrics are derived with it at MOM_grid.F90:420-424 (IdxT = 1/dxT, IdyT = 1/dyT, IareaT = 1/areaT); a consumer holding the positive metric lengths applies this template to each to obtain the free-name reciprocals (the dump supplies the reciprocals directly, so the traced stage-2 model binds them rather than deriving).

I_Rho0.description: 1/rho0, the Boussinesq density scaling of the PGF.

IdxCu.description: 1/zonal face length at the east faces.

IdyCv.description: 1/meridional face length at the north faces.

PFu.description: Zonal pressure-gradient acceleration on the east faces.

PFv.description: Meridional pressure-gradient acceleration on the north faces.

P_int.description: Vertical integral of the pressure anomaly over layer k, the g1 numerator group of the face law.

Z_to_H.description: Depth-to-height conversion of the e_bot correction term.

dP_x.description: East-face pressure-difference group g1 + g2, the diff_x rule assembly target.

dP_y.description: North-face pressure-difference group, the dP_x mirror with the s/n neighbours.

e_bot.description: Interface height below layer k at the cells.

h.description: Layer thickness at the cells (start-of-step, the pgf dump's h).

h_neglect.description: Thickness denominator floor of the face acceleration.

intx_dpa.description: Layer change of intx_pa along the east faces.

intx_pa.description: Interface integral of the pressure anomaly along the east faces divided by the grid spacing.

inty_dpa.description: Layer change of inty_pa along the north faces.

inty_pa.description: Interface integral of the pressure anomaly along the north faces divided by the grid spacing.

intz_dpa.description: Vertical integral in depth of the pressure anomaly less the top pressure anomaly, over the layer.

pa_top.description: Pressure anomaly at the top interface of layer k at the cells.
